finding: Standalone4x4 WebGL2 reproduces warning with correctly ordered PBO writes/readbacks and all8 pixel checks/GL_NO_ERROR. No emulator guest involved. Chrome151 matching-tag Blink getBufferSubData calls GetBufferSubDataCHROMIUM, whose client implementation copies from separate mapped memory and does not free the tracked readback shadow. AllocateShadowCopiesForReadback warns when Alloc reports retained allocation. Inference: browser shadow-tracking behavior explains warning without an emulator overwrite; not a claim of measured performance neutrality.
scope: 4 frames immediate readback plus4 fence-waited frames. Warning log is combined acrossbothcases, not individuallyattributed. No benchmarking, generic renderer fix, or public deployment.
